_doc: Seed corpus for ci/guard_diff.py; see docs/guard-diff.md. A string entry is checked in worker mode (--role coder); an object {"cmd", "modes"} is checked in each listed mode (worker, hq). must_allow strings are checked in both modes. An entry with "role" (e.g. "evaluator") runs in worker mode only, under that role; for evaluator the tool and the sanity test set FACTORY_HOME to a temp dir in the hook's environment. The token @SHARED@ is a temp stand-in for the shared checkout (the hook gets WORKER_GUARD_LIVE_HOME for commands naming it).
